description: Mozambique Cyclone Idai Data is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobile Accord, Inc. (GeoPoll). This dataset includes 700 completed interviews from Mozambique following Cyclone Idai, including respondents from Sofala province and Beira. All respondents were affected by the cyclone, and data includes information on home and community damages, food security, and access to resources including clean water and electricity. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Mobile Accord, Inc. (GeoPoll). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, food security, natural disasters. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
